### Spirit-Filled Boldness
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-5-2024.html
Passage: Judges 7:10-11
Points:
- Fear often tempts believers to hold back rather than step forward in obedient faith.
- God meets human hesitation with gentle patience and reassurance instead of rebuke.
- Slipping into the enemy camp allowed Gideon to hear proof of God's sovereign work.
- Gideon responded to God's advance reassurance with heartfelt, private worship before entering battle.
- True boldness stems not from human self-confidence, but from humble reliance on God's sufficiency.
